component.name: Glate
component.summary: Translate text and generate speech audio on Linux desktop

description.p: Glate is a fast desktop translator with built-in text-to-speech for everyday translation workflows.
It supports translation across 100+ languages, per-line translation view, voice playback, history tracking, and sharing translated text or speech output.

ul.li: Line-by-line translation view for structured content
Text-to-speech playback with voice and gender options
Export speech output as MP3 audio
Translation history with search and quick copy
Share translations via public paste link
Dark and light themes with automatic system detection

screenshot.caption: Main translation view with dark theme

description.p: Major update with reworked UX, improved sharing, and single-instance enforcement.

ul.li: Single-instance enforcement: raising the existing window when app is launched again
History window overhauled: item selection, theming, and layout improvements
TTS buttons now disabled when source text is empty
Paste sharing now correctly handles UTF-8 text including CJK and Devanagari scripts
Plan comparison dialog shows Free, Evaluation, and Pro feature differences
Dark and light theme contrast improvements across dialogs
Snap packaging updated to core24 with CMake-based builds
Added Flatpak manifest and CI release artifacts
Aligned desktop metadata with reverse-DNS app ID for stores
